what: single VIIRS over MODIS FRP ratio for the overlap-ratio baseline

fit.trained_on: real FIRMS rows of plumas_ca, lytton_bc, evia_greece context boxes, years 2018, 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023, 2021, with the three 2021 test fires excluded (backend/model/training.py)
fit.definition: Pairs are one MODIS overpass and the VIIRS overpass nearest in time, at most 90 minutes apart, both with detections in the training rows given. ratio = sum of VIIRS FRP / sum of MODIS FRP over all pairs; the percentiles are of the per pair ratios.

outside_reference: Sofiev and Kouznetsov (GMD 19, 10123, 2026) report 177 TW for VIIRS against 128 TW for MODIS over the 2020 Aqua and Suomi NPP granules worldwide, a ratio of 1.38
